title: Adam and Hawwa in the Garden
art: Adam and Hawwa appear only as two distant figures of light seen from behind. The Quran does not name the tree's fruit, so it is drawn as no particular kind.
imagePrompt: A breathtaking paradise garden: rivers of clear water, golden light pouring through endless trees, fruit glowing like lanterns; two tiny soft figures of white-gold light seen far away from behind; one tree standing apart with deeper, darker green leaves, faintly shimmering, quiet and forbidding, kept in frame; luminous jewel-like greens and golds.

beats.say: Adam and Hawwa were given the Garden: clear rivers, golden light, fruit glowing like lanterns.
Everything in it was theirs to enjoy.

verse.en: O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will.

beats.say: One tree stood apart, its leaves darker than the rest.

verse.en: But do not approach this tree…
